fix_design_result.supported_remediation_boundary: Preserve Suggested Content field identity across the request, Supervision scan, response, and fanmgmt comparison boundaries.
fix_design_result.supported_intended_change: Add optional field-local text and infraction-field identity while preserving scalar text and unqualified extents as the legacy path.

interface_contract.surface: fanmgmt eos_run_compliance suggested-content event and Supervision CreateWorkflowItem infraction response
interface_contract.request_shape: Add optional suggested_content_data.text_fields as an object mapping existing fanmgmt field keys to strings, including message, link_title, and link_summary. Keep top-level text unchanged as the legacy scalar message.
interface_contract.response_shape: Add optional field to each returned infraction alongside compliance_rule and extents. Extents are relative to that exact field string, and fanmgmt converts a qualified infraction to InfractionType extents {field: extents}.
interface_contract.absence_semantics: Absent text_fields retains scalar processing. Absent infraction.field retains legacy key 0 behavior and must not be inferred as link_title or link_summary.
interface_contract.compatibility_precedence: Field-local input and qualified response extents take precedence when present; legacy producers and consumers retain scalar text and unqualified extents.
interface_contract.rollout: Deploy tolerant consumers before field-aware producers and qualified response writers; roll back population and qualification while retaining tolerant readers.
